MERGE INTO MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE CII USING (
SELECT '${item.exchargeCode}' EXCHARGE_CODE, #{item.tradeDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null TRADE_DATE, '${item.datasourceType}' DATASOURCE_TYPE, ${item.openPrice}null OPEN_PRICE, ${item.closePrice}null CLOSE_PRICE, ${item.highPrice}null HIGH_PRICE, ${item.lowPrice}null LOW_PRICE, ${item.midPrice}null MID_PRICE, '${item.basisCyy}' BASIS_CYY, '${item.quotCyy}' QUOT_CYY, ${item.quotUnit}null QUOT_UNIT, '${item.inputType}' INPUT_TYPE, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, current date CREATE_TIME, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, current date UPDATE_TIME FROM sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
) TEMP
ON(CII.EXCHARGE_CODE = TEMP.EXCHARGE_CODE AND CII.TRADE_DATE = TEMP.TRADE_DATE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DATASOURCE_TYPE = TEMP.DATASOURCE_TYPE, OPEN_PRICE = TEMP.OPEN_PRICE, CLOSE_PRICE = TEMP.CLOSE_PRICE, HIGH_PRICE = TEMP.HIGH_PRICE, LOW_PRICE = TEMP.LOW_PRICE, MID_PRICE = TEMP.MID_PRICE, BASIS_CYY = TEMP.BASIS_CYY, QUOT_CYY = TEMP.QUOT_CYY, QUOT_UNIT = TEMP.QUOT_UNIT, INPUT_TYPE = TEMP.INPUT_TYPE, CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EXCHARGE_CODE, TRADE_DATE, DATASOURCE_TYPE, OPEN_PRICE, CLOSE_PRICE, HIGH_PRICE, LOW_PRICE, MID_PRICE, BASIS_CYY, QUOT_CYY, QUOT_UNIT, INPUT_TYPE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (TEMP.EXCHARGE_CODE, TEMP.TRADE_DATE, TEMP.DATASOURCE_TYPE, TEMP.OPEN_PRICE, TEMP.CLOSE_PRICE, TEMP.HIGH_PRICE, TEMP.LOW_PRICE, TEMP.MID_PRICE, TEMP.BASIS_CYY, TEMP.QUOT_CYY, TEMP.QUOT_UNIT, TEMP.INPUT_TYPE, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME)
